📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
Occurrence #360 — every-10th resurface (last DM 2026-06-09 17:33Z, ~22.5h ago; within 24h window but the %10 milestone resurfaces so it doesn't go invisible).
Channel: #alert-frontend-errors • 11 alerts in group • Datadog bot B011R3D650X / monitor 77419271 (Warn, last_triggered 16:07:11Z)

*Symptoms:* 93 distinct accounts, status_code:0 XHR errors, all on `GET /gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/<account>/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync`. Chronic baseline (93 ≈ recent 91–107), *not* the 100x 2026-06-04 outage surge.
Top accounts: acentel(13), diamondbladedistributorsllc(10), bodegatile(10), EnglandLogistics(10), stjosephshospitalfoundation2(9).

*Likely cause:* chronic ms-gateway-api Ocelot timeouts proxying to microservices.methodlocal.int Tier-3 pool (sync-util). Residual since the 2026-06-05 rollback; no new deploy.
⚠️ *Shared-upstream co-fire* with ki-24 (runtime-core RTC p95 15.55s + 74 Redis errors, #alert-system) in this same window — per precedence_note, treat as one upstream event (microservices.methodlocal.int pool + runtime-core RTC/Redis backpressure).

*Playbook:* compare Ocelot Warning volume vs 24h ago (chronic if <20% delta) → check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota → identify slow downstream via ms-gateway-api ocelot config → fix decision tree: raise per-route timeout / scale Tier-3 IIS pool / profile sync-util slow path.
Open Jira: none (fix_status: chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05)

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
Occurrence #120 — 24h suppression window elapsed (last DM 2026-06-09 15:08Z, ~25h ago → resurfaces).
Channel: #alert-system • 4 alerts in group • Datadog bot B011R3D650X / monitor 115456700 (RTC Screen Load p95, last_triggered 15:16:20Z)

*Symptoms:* RTC Screen Load p95 peaked *15.55s* (5x the 3s threshold; ratio 4.18) with 8 breach points >3s in the 15:05–15:20Z window. *0 runtime-core error logs* → canonical latency-only signature. *74 Redis command errors* time-locked to the p95 burst (monitor 227940275 last_triggered 15:15:35Z).

*Likely cause:* runtime-core-api RTC latency spike with Redis backpressure. No runtime-core deploy since 2026-05-06 (35+ days) → not a code regression. Consistent with chronic shared-upstream contention (per-tenant burst / Redis).
⚠️ *Shared-upstream co-fire* with ki-21 (93-account syncwidget XHR fan-out, #alert-frontend-errors) in this same window — per precedence_note, likely one upstream event (microservices.methodlocal.int pool + runtime-core RTC/Redis backpressure) rather than two independent issues.

*Playbook:* confirm pattern via RTC p95 metric (done: multiple >3s) → confirm latency-only via 0 error logs (done) → inspect DD APM outlier traces (`@duration:>5s`) for the slow SQL/Mongo/Redis span → mitigate (raise threshold / per-resource circuit breaker / targeted index fix).
Open Jira: none (fix_status: investigating — no owner; root-cause Jira still recommended)

_Severity note:_ 15.55s p95 + 74 Redis errors + recurring co-fire with ki-21 → strong case for the proposed severity-based escalation override and a runtime-core RTC root-cause ticket. Flagging for next stability-review.
